# Setup

Loads packages for token summaries, Bayesian modeling, and plotting, and configures knitr to stop on chunk errors.

```{r packages, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(brms)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
```

```{r knitr_options}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
```

# Load Data

Creates the French model and processed-data directories, loads the processed token table from Feather, and defines `pas` and `non` as the selected negation words. Counts full monthly token totals for the later word and category tables.

```{r processedTokens}
french_data_dir <- "../french/french_data/processed_data"
french_model_dir <- "../french/french_model/modeling"

dir.create(french_model_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(french_data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

french_tokens_processed <- read_feather(
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_tokens_processed.feather")
)

french_negation_words <- c("pas", "non")

french_observed_speaker_age_totals <- french_tokens_processed %>%
  count(speaker, age, name = "total")

french_speaker_age_totals <- bind_rows(
  french_observed_speaker_age_totals %>%
    filter(speaker == "child") %>%
    complete(age = 0:10, fill = list(speaker = "child", total = 0L)) %>%
    mutate(total = if_else(age <= 10, 0L, total)),
  french_observed_speaker_age_totals %>%
    filter(speaker != "child")
) %>%
  arrange(speaker, age)
```

# Computing Cumulative Relative Frequencies

Counts full monthly token totals before computing syntactic, word, and semantic-category rates. Keeps child ages 0–10 as zero baselines and excludes later zero-occurrence months only from each word’s cumulative denominator.

## Function vs. Content Words

Calculates monthly and cumulative percentages for the processed `syncategory` labels and saves the table. `Function` contains the selected target negators; `nonfunction` contains all other retained tokens, including any other linguistic function words.

```{r syncategory_relfreq}
french_syncategory_relfreq <-
  french_tokens_processed %>%
  group_by(syncategory, speaker, age) %>%
  summarise(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(
    nesting(speaker, age),
    syncategory = c("Function", "nonfunction"),
    fill = list(freq = 0L)
  ) %>%
  complete(
    nesting(syncategory) %>% mutate(speaker = "child"),
    age = 0:10,
    fill = list(freq = 0L)
  ) %>%
  mutate(freq = if_else(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0L, freq)) %>%
  group_by(speaker, age) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(freq),
    relfreq = if_else(total > 0, freq / total, 0),
    pct = relfreq * 100
  ) %>%
  group_by(syncategory, speaker) %>%
  arrange(age, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
    cum_total = cumsum(total),
    cumulative_relfreq = if_else(cum_total > 0, cum_freq / cum_total, 0),
    cumulative_pct = cumulative_relfreq * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(syncategory, speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, pct,
         cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq, cumulative_pct) %>%
  ungroup()

saveRDS(
  french_syncategory_relfreq,
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_syncategory_relfreq.RDS")
)
```

## Individual Function Words

Maps classified `pas` and `non` tokens to word rows and calculates their rates against full monthly token totals. Retains child ages 0–10 as zero baselines and accumulates each word’s counts and totals only in later months where it occurs.

```{r functionword_relfreq}
french_functionword_relfreq <-
  french_tokens_processed %>%
  mutate(
    # Use classified categories rather than raw spellings.
    # Other tokens remain available for the denominator.
    word = if_else(
      negation_category %in% french_negation_words,
      as.character(negation_category),
      "nonfunction"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(word, speaker, age) %>%
  summarise(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(
    nesting(speaker, age),
    word = c(french_negation_words, "nonfunction"),
    fill = list(freq = 0L)
  ) %>%
  complete(
    nesting(word) %>% mutate(speaker = "child"),
    age = 0:10,
    fill = list(freq = 0L)
  ) %>%
  # Retain the existing early-age modeling convention.
  mutate(
    freq = if_else(
      speaker == "child" & age <= 10,
      0L,
      freq
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(french_speaker_age_totals, by = c("speaker", "age")) %>%
  mutate(
    total = replace_na(total, 0L),
    relfreq = if_else(total > 0, freq / total, 0),
    ppt = relfreq * 1000
  ) %>%
  filter(word %in% french_negation_words,
         freq > 0 | (speaker == "child" & age %in% 0:10)) %>%
  group_by(word, speaker) %>%
  arrange(age, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
    cum_total = cumsum(total),
    cumulative_relfreq = if_else(
      cum_total > 0,
      cum_freq / cum_total,
      0
    ),
    cumulative_ppt = cumulative_relfreq * 1000
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(word, speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, ppt,
         cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq, cumulative_ppt) %>%
  ungroup()

saveRDS(
  french_functionword_relfreq,
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_functionword_relfreq.RDS")
)
```

## Function Word Semantic Categories

Counts classified `pas` and `non` tokens directly from the processed table against full monthly totals, independent of word-specific exclusions. Saves monthly parts per thousand and cumulative relative frequency for the combined `Negation` category.

```{r wordcategory_relfreq}
french_wordcategory_relfreq <-
  french_speaker_age_totals %>%
  left_join(
    french_tokens_processed %>%
      filter(negation_category %in% french_negation_words) %>%
      count(speaker, age, name = "freq"),
    by = c("speaker", "age")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    word_category = "Negation",
    freq = replace_na(freq, 0L),
    freq = if_else(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0L, freq),
    relfreq = if_else(total > 0, freq / total, 0),
    ppt = relfreq * 1000
  ) %>%
  group_by(word_category, speaker) %>%
  arrange(age, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
    cum_total = cumsum(total),
    cumulative_relfreq = if_else(
      cum_total > 0,
      cum_freq / cum_total,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(word_category, speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, ppt,
         cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq) %>%
  ungroup()

saveRDS(
  french_wordcategory_relfreq,
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_wordcategory_relfreq.RDS")
)
```

# Plots and Growth Curves

Plots monthly category percentages and cumulative word rates, fits Bayesian Gompertz curves to child data, and displays observations with fitted values. Saves the fitted child tables and scope-labeled plot objects where specified.

## Overall Negation Production

Plots monthly percentages for the combined `pas` and `non` category by speaker and fits a child Gompertz curve when child negation counts are present. Saves child data with fitted values, then creates and displays the child observed-versus-fitted plot.

```{r negation_words_plot, echo=FALSE}
french_negation_words_relfreq <- french_wordcategory_relfreq %>%
  mutate(pct = relfreq * 100)

french_negation_words_plot <- french_negation_words_relfreq %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, pct)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(. ~ speaker) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Negation",
    x = "Age (Months)",
    y = "Monthly Percent of Tokens"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

french_negation_words_plot
```

```{r negation_words_growth_model, include=FALSE}
french_negation_words_childdata <- french_negation_words_relfreq %>%
  filter(speaker == "child") %>%
  arrange(age)

if (!any(french_negation_words_childdata$freq > 0)) {
  stop("No retained child negation tokens are available for modeling.")
}

french_negation_words_lagModel <- brm(
  bf(
    pct ~ upperAsymptote *
      exp(-exp(((growthRate * exp(1)) / upperAsymptote) *
                 (lag - age) + 1)),
    upperAsymptote ~ 1,
    growthRate ~ 1,
    lag ~ 1,
    nl = TRUE
  ),
  data = french_negation_words_childdata,
  prior = c(
    prior(
      uniform(0, 100),
      nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = 100
    ),
    prior(
      uniform(0, 10),
      nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10
    ),
    prior(
      uniform(10, 72),
      nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72
    )
  ),
  file = file.path(french_model_dir, "french_negation_words_lagModel"),
  file_refit = "on_change",
  iter = 10000,
  seed = 2026
)
```

```{r negation_words_predictions}
french_negation_words_predictions <- as.data.frame(
  fitted(french_negation_words_lagModel)
)

french_negation_words_childdata$predictions <-
  french_negation_words_predictions[, "Estimate"]

saveRDS(
  french_negation_words_childdata,
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_negation_words_childdata.RDS")
)
```

```{r negation_words_prediction_plot}
french_negation_words_plot <- ggplot(
  french_negation_words_childdata,
  aes(age, pct)
) +
  geom_point(aes(color = "Actual Data"), size = 2) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = predictions, color = "Fitted Values"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Actual Data" = "black", "Fitted Values" = "blue")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Negation",
    x = "Child Age (Month)",
    y = "Monthly Percent of Tokens"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

french_negation_words_plot
```

## Distribution of Individual Function Words

Plots cumulative parts per thousand for `pas` and `non` by speaker, fits child growth curves, and records fitted values and lag estimates for later displays.

### Negation

Analyzes the selected `pas` and `non` rows from the saved word-frequency table. The later scope-labeled panels reuse these word-level curves.

##### pas

Plots cumulative occurrences per 1,000 tokens for `pas` by speaker, fits a child Gompertz curve, and saves child data with fitted values. Displays the child fit plot and records the model lag estimate.

```{r pas_plot, echo=FALSE}
french_functionword_relfreq %>%
  filter(word == "pas") %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, cumulative_ppt)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(. ~ speaker) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "pas",
    x = "Age (Months)",
    y = "Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens"
  )
```

```{r pas_growth_model, include=FALSE}
french_pas_childdata <- french_functionword_relfreq %>%
  filter(word == "pas", speaker == "child") %>%
  arrange(age)

if (!any(french_pas_childdata$freq > 0)) {
  stop("No retained child uses of 'pas' are available for modeling.")
}

# Retain the existing French upper-asymptote prior.
french_pas_upper_bound <- max(
  5,
  ceiling(max(french_pas_childdata$cumulative_ppt) * 2)
)

french_pas_lagModel <- brm(
  bf(
    cumulative_ppt ~ upperAsymptote *
      exp(-exp(
        ((growthRate * exp(1)) / upperAsymptote) *
          (lag - age) + 1
      )),
    upperAsymptote ~ 1,
    growthRate ~ 1,
    lag ~ 1,
    nl = TRUE
  ),
  data = french_pas_childdata,
  prior = c(
    set_prior(
      sprintf("uniform(0, %s)", french_pas_upper_bound),
      nlpar = "upperAsymptote",
      lb = 0,
      ub = french_pas_upper_bound
    ),
    prior(
      uniform(0, 10),
      nlpar = "growthRate",
      lb = 0,
      ub = 10
    ),
    prior(
      uniform(10, 72),
      nlpar = "lag",
      lb = 10,
      ub = 72
    )
  ),
  file = file.path(french_model_dir, "french_pas_lagModel"),
  file_refit = "on_change",
  iter = 10000,
  seed = 2026
)
```

```{r pas_predictions}
french_pas_predictions <- as.data.frame(fitted(french_pas_lagModel))

french_pas_childdata$predictions <- french_pas_predictions[, "Estimate"]

saveRDS(
  french_pas_childdata,
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_pas_childdata.RDS")
)
```

```{r pas_age_of_production}
french_pas_lag <- fixef(french_pas_lagModel)[3, ]

french_pas_age_of_production <- tibble(
  word = "pas",
  Estimate = round(french_pas_lag[["Estimate"]], 1),
  Est.Error = round(french_pas_lag[["Est.Error"]], 1),
  Q2.5 = round(french_pas_lag[["Q2.5"]], 1),
  Q97.5 = round(french_pas_lag[["Q97.5"]], 1)
)
```

```{r pas_prediction_plot}
french_pas_plot <-
  ggplot(french_pas_childdata, aes(age, cumulative_ppt)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = "Actual Data"), size = 2) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = predictions, color = "Fitted Values"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Legend",
    values = c(
      "Actual Data" = "black",
      "Fitted Values" = "blue"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "pas",
    x = "Child Age (Month)",
    y = "Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14)
  )

french_pas_plot
```

#### Sentential and Discourse Negation

Labels the fitted `pas` child data as sentential and the fitted `non` child data as discourse, retaining their zero baselines and word-specific cumulative rates. Saves those copied tables and defines a shared plot of cumulative observations and fitted values; it does not filter tokens by their original `negation_scope` labels.

```{r negation_scope_curve_data, include=FALSE}
# Reuse the previously calculated frequencies and fitted predictions.
# Run pas_predictions and non_predictions first.

french_sentential_negation_childdata <- french_pas_childdata %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(age) %>%
  mutate(
    negation_category = "pas",
    negation_scope = "sentential"
  )

french_discourse_negation_childdata <- french_non_childdata %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(age) %>%
  mutate(
    negation_category = "non",
    negation_scope = "discourse"
  )

saveRDS(
  french_sentential_negation_childdata,
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_sentential_negation_childdata.RDS")
)

saveRDS(
  french_discourse_negation_childdata,
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_discourse_negation_childdata.RDS")
)

# Plot cumulative frequencies as black points and fitted values in blue.
french_plot_child_negation <- function(plot_data, plot_title) {
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(age, cumulative_ppt)) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
    geom_line(
      aes(y = predictions),
      color = "blue",
      linewidth = 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ negation_category,
      ncol = 2,
      scales = "free_y"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, 12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Child Age (Months)",
      y = "Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}
```

##### Sentential

Creates, saves, and displays the `pas` child plot labeled as sentential negation.

```{r sentential_graph}
french_sentential_negation_child_plot <- french_plot_child_negation(
  filter(french_sentential_negation_childdata, negation_category == "pas"),
  "Sentential Negation in Children"
)

saveRDS(
  french_sentential_negation_child_plot,
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_sentential_negation_child_plot.RDS")
)

french_sentential_negation_child_plot
```

# Age of Production Plot

Combines the two word-model lag estimates and their 95% credible intervals, saves and displays the table, and displays a point-and-interval plot. Lag is a growth-curve parameter rather than a directly observed first-production age.

```{r age_of_production_build}
french_age_of_production <- bind_rows(
  french_pas_age_of_production,
  french_non_age_of_production
) %>%
  arrange(Estimate) %>%
  mutate(word = fct_reorder(word, Estimate))

saveRDS(
  french_age_of_production,
  file.path(french_data_dir, "french_age_of_production.RDS")
)

french_age_of_production
```

```{r age_of_production_plot}
french_negation_onsetage_plot <-
  ggplot(french_age_of_production, aes(x = Estimate, y = word)) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 3)) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (Months)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

french_negation_onsetage_plot
```
